text:
harper: Quick ask  can someone craft a single-page, manager-only rapid onboarding playbook for hybrid hires? Need: day0 logistics, a manager checklist for week1, calendar snippets, and a copy-paste 30/60/90 with measurable goals managers can reuse. New Eng Manager starts next Wed.
marta: I'll make a tight one-pager. Must include: laptop pickup vs ship, badge/QR instructions, buddy assignment, first-week 1:1s, and a short "manager to-do" list (permissions, OKRs, skip-level).
devin: IT notes to include: imaging windows Tue 4-6pm & Wed 8-10am. We push image tag `rwi-hybrid-2026-lite`. For shipping, default UPS 2-day unless manager requests overnight. Managers should copy this minimal provision snippet to IT:```
Provision request:
name: {name}
email: {email}
teams: {team}
os: mac|linux
tools: slack,github,notion,okta
```
iori: Add an explicit manager-only action: schedule a 30-min "context tour" with tech lead by Day3 and a 30-min skip-level in week4. Also require managers to set a 30-day success blurb on the hire's first 1:1.
onboard-bot: Reminder: intake form will auto-enroll new hires to #new-hires and queue SSO + security training invites when manager completes the form. Please mark in-office days so we schedule badge pickup.
harper: Good. Calendar paste snippets managers can use:```
Day0 (before start): DM new hire with pickup options + parking notes
Day1 09:00-09:30: Welcome + IT setup (Manager + IT + Buddy)
Day1 10:00-10:30: Team intro + standup (All)
Day2 11:00-12:00: Codebase walkthrough (Buddy + Tech lead)
Day4 14:00-14:30: 30-day goals sync (Manager + New hire)
Week1 Fri 15:00-15:30: Week1 wrap + feedback
```
marta: Short day-by-day manager checklist (one-line bullets managers can tick):
- Before start: complete intake (shipping, OS, in-office days, breakfast RSVP)
- Day0: DM with pickup window + parking / QR instructions
- Day1: 30-min setup + assign buddy + intro standup
- Day2-3: permissions & repo access granted; schedule tech tour
- Day4-5: small scoped task + end-of-week 30-min check in
- End of week: set concrete 30-day success criteria and add to calendar

devin: Badge & building logistics to paste: "Badge pickup: Wed 8:30-10:00 & Thu 4:00-5:30 at Security Desk. For QR access, pre-register hire email in intake to pre-approve." Add parking note: "Visitor passes available; manager to confirm reimbursement if staff travels."
iori: 30/60/90 (copyable manager version; measurable):
- 30 days: 2 PRs merged (small fixes), deployed at least once in staging with guidance, completed security training, presented a 30-day learning plan.
- 60 days: own one small feature/bug fix end-to-end, reduce time-to-merge for PRs in owned area by 10%, participate in two design or arch reviews.
- 90 days: lead rollout of a minor feature or improvement, merge 5 PRs across features, propose 1 process improvement accepted by team.
harper: Include a short "what success looks like at 30 days" blurb managers can paste: "Can navigate core repos, deploy a small change with review, passed key trainings, and outlined a 60-day growth plan."
marta: DM templates managers can copy: Day0 DM to hire: "Hey <name>  excited to have you onboard! You can pick up your laptop Wed 9-11am (Bldg A reception) or we can ship to your address. Bring photo ID for badge. First day 9am: quick setup with IT + 30-min intro with me. Reply with pickup preference.  <manager>"
Dev-to-IT snippet (manager copy): "Provision: {name,email,team,os,tools}. Please stage image `rwi-hybrid-2026-lite` and enable Okta SSO."
it-bot: Note: If intake is submitted before Friday 3pm we can pre-stage imaging and badge pre-approval. Otherwise expect Day1 provisioning.
onboard-bot: Action items created: (1) Publish rapid manager playbook -> marta, (2) Update intake to add "in-office days" and "OS preference" -> people-ops, (3) Create calendar ICS bundle -> harper. Due: EOD today.
devin: One more practical manager-only checklist item: confirm workstation ergonomics stipend (we have a $75 voucher) and budget approval for any specialty device before Day14.
marta: I'll keep the one-pager visually tiny (checkboxes + copyable snippets) and include a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: "If GitHub access missing after 24h -> ping infra-oncall; if badge missing -> contact Security with intake email."
harper: Sweet. Can folks glance the draft in 30m? I want to drop it into Notion under Onboarding > Manager Playbooks and DM this to hiring managers.
iori: I'll drop a short measurable 30/60/90 example into DM after lunch you can include as appendix.
onboard-bot: Reminder: security training & SSO must be completed within the first 7 days; manager attest required on Day7.
harper: Thanks team 44d I'll compile and publish once you ack the draft.
